description: Fields from competitors/findings.jsonl that the contract has no place for, keyed by contract record_id / claim_id. Not read by the team validator or exporter.

luis:bmw_baseline_outlook-E0031.trim_scope: i5 eDrive40, MY2027 (also 530i/530i xDrive per 2023 release)
luis:bmw_baseline_outlook-E0031.value: Front ventilated seats in the Luxury Seating Package, $1,350 (with front and rear heated seats)
luis:bmw_baseline_outlook-E0031.notes: 2023 US press release lists the Luxury Seating Package (front ventilated seats, front and rear heated seats) for i5 eDrive40, 530i and 530i xDrive. US package is cheaper and narrower than DE Comfort Paket 7VB (EUR 2,750).

luis:bmw_baseline_outlook-E0032.value: Massage seats not mentioned in fetched US sources
luis:bmw_baseline_outlook-E0032.notes: Neither the cars.com MY2027 i5 package list nor the 2023 US press release mention massage. DE price list has none (E0011).

luis:bmw_baseline_outlook-E0033.value: Rear heated seats only via Luxury Seating Package ($1,350); rear climate zones, rear screens, rear ventilation/recline not mentioned
luis:bmw_baseline_outlook-E0033.notes: Rear legroom 37 in (cars.com). 2023 US press release says standard climate is automatic air conditioning; 4-zone not mentioned.

luis:bmw_baseline_outlook-E0038.value: Wheelbase 118 in (117.9 in = 2,995 mm per BMW); rear legroom 37 in (approx. 940 mm)
luis:bmw_baseline_outlook-E0038.notes: Same body as EU (no long wheelbase in US). Rear legroom is a US SAE-style figure from cars.com, not directly comparable with Chinese mm figures.

luis:bmw_baseline_outlook-E0042.value: Sky Lounge panoramic roof optional in place of the standard tilt-and-slide moonroof; on MY2027 i5 eDrive40 part of Executive Package ($3,600)
luis:bmw_baseline_outlook-E0042.notes: 2023 US press release: standard slide-and-tilt moonroof, Sky Lounge optional. KBB MY2027: 'Panorama Moon Roof' optional on 530i. Difference to DE: US gets a standard moonroof, DE gets none.
